_notes: tree_sitter_java 0.23.5. Every Java method lives in a type, so method_declaration / constructor_declaration / compact_constructor_declaration (records) are always kind 'method' (listed in 'methods'). lambda_expression is a definition like JavaScript arrow_function; method_containers is empty so lambdas are kind 'function' (otherwise every lambda would be a 'method' because it always sits inside a class). Classes: class, interface, enum, record and @interface declarations; anonymous class bodies (object_creation_expression > class_body) are not definitions. Abstract/interface/native methods without a body are method_declaration nodes too (no distinct prototype type in this grammar) and are counted. annotation_type_element_declaration (@interface members) is not a definition. Doc comments: block_comment starting with '/**' (Javadoc). None of the listed types is also an anonymous token in this grammar (the only named/anonymous overlaps are 'permits' and 'throws').
